Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: A Trade message is sent when there is an execution on the order book.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Source Time

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index message

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The symbol sequence number.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for this trade.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the Trade. Use the Price scale from the Symbol Index Mapping message.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The volume of the trade in shares.

Field.Name: TradeCond1
Field.Description: Settlement related conditions.

Field.Name: TradeCond2
Field.Description: The reason for Trade Through Exemptions.

Field.Name: TradeCond3
Field.Description: Extended hours/sequencing related conditions.

Field.Name: TradeCond4
Field.Description: SRO Required Detail.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Message
Message.Description: In the event that an earlier trade has been reported in error, a Trade Cancel message is sent.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Source Time

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index Mapping message.

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The symbol sequence number.

Field.Name: OriginalTradeID
Field.Description: The original TradeID of the Trade being cancelled.

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: In the event that an earlier trade has been reported with one or multiple fields in error, a Trade Correction message is sent.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Source Time

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index Mapping message.

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The symbol sequence number.

Field.Name: OriginalTradeID
Field.Description: The original TradeID of the Trade message being corrected.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: The TradeID of the corrected Trade message.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The corrected price of the Trade. Use the Price scale from the Symbol Index Mapping message.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The corrected volume of the trade in shares.

Field.Name: TradeCond1
Field.Description: Settlement related conditions.

Field.Name: TradeCond2
Field.Description: The reason for Trade Through Exemptions.

Field.Name: TradeCond3
Field.Description: Extended hours/sequencing related conditions.

Field.Name: TradeCond4
Field.Description: SRO Required Detail.

Message.Name: Stock Summary Message
Message.Description: The stock summary message is sent every 1 minute on a separate channel from the main trades feed.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the Source Time

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index message.

Field.Name: HighPrice
Field.Description: The High price of the stock for the day. Use the Price scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: LowPrice
Field.Description: The Low price of the stock for the day. Use the Price scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: Open
Field.Description: The Opening price of the stock for the day. Use the Price scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: Close
Field.Description: The Closing price of the stock for the day. Use the Price scale from the symbol mapping index.

Field.Name: TotalVolume
Field.Description: The cumulative volume for the stock throughout the day.

Message.Name: TRF Fractional Trade Message
Message.Description: TRF Fractional Trade Message. New message effective 1/12/26.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: The ID of the symbol in the Symbol Index message

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: The symbol sequence number.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for this trade.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the Trade. Use the Price scale from the Symbol Index Mapping message.

Field.Name: FractionalVolume
Field.Description: The volume of the trade in shares, inclusive of any fractional quantity. Implied scale is 6.

Field.Name: TradeCond1
Field.Description: Settlement related conditions.

Field.Name: TradeCond2
Field.Description: The reason for Trade Through Exemptions.

Field.Name: TradeCond3
Field.Description: Extended hours/sequencing related conditions.

Field.Name: TradeCond4
Field.Description: SRO Required Detail.

Field.Name: ExecDayTime
Field.Description: The date and time when this Trade occurred at the participant firm, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: ExecDayTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the ExecutionDayTime.

Message.Name: TRF Fractional Prior Day Trade Cancel Message
Message.Description: If a TRF participant firm discovers that it has reported a trade with an inaccurate price or volume on a previous day, the firm may correct the trade on a subsequent day by publishing a Prior Day Trade Cancel message, followed by a Prior Day Trade. New message effective 1/12/26.
